title: China Grows ~72% of the World's Garlic — and Eats It Raw | China Travel Expert
description:
China produced about 21.6 million tonnes of garlic in 2024 — roughly 72% of the entire world's supply. That's close to 3 of every 4 garlic bulbs on the planet.

And a lot of it is eaten raw. In northern China, raw garlic turns up right on the table at noodle shops and BBQ stands, and a clove is crushed into the black-vinegar dip that boiled dumplings (jiaozi) get dragged through. To a lot of travellers it's a shock; to locals it's just dinner.

🧭 Expert Tip: at a northern noodle or skewer stand, raw garlic is often sitting in a bowl on the counter for free — try one clove between bites, the way regulars do.

生蒜配饺子、就着面——在中国北方，蒜不是配料，是态度。你敢生吃吗？
